package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseFilteredDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
	a := batch(1, "worker", "api", 1, 0, 10_000_000_000, 11_000_000_000)
	b := batch(2, "frontend", "rpc", 1, 0, 20_000_000_000, 21_000_000_000)
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", "api"), value("pred.a", "left"), value("only.api", "first"), value("filter.text", "first\nsecond"), value("empty", ""), {Key: "retries", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: -9223372036854775808}}}, {Key: "cached", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: false}}}, {Key: "opaque", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BytesValue{BytesValue: []byte("abc")}}}}
	sibling := batch(1, "worker", "rpc-sibling", 2, 1, 12_000_000_000, 13_000_000_000).ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
	sibling.Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", "rpc"), value("pred.b", "right"), value("only.sibling", "second"), value("empty", ""), {Key: "retries", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: 7}}}, {Key: "cached", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: true}}}}
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans = append(a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans, sibling)
	b.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", "rpc"), {Key: "retries", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: 9223372036854775807}}}}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{a, b}}
	var rows []*Trace
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		tr := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	ctx := context.Background()
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	type Case struct {
		Name      string      `json:"name"`
		Query     string      `json:"query"`
		Target    string      `json:"target"`
		Supported bool        `json:"supported"`
		Response  interface{} `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{
		{Name: "resource-to-span", Query: `{resource.service.name="worker"}`, Target: "span.retries", Supported: true},
		{Name: "span-to-resource", Query: `{span.request.kind="api"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "other-resource", Query: `{resource.service.name="frontend"}`, Target: "span.retries", Supported: true},
		{Name: "same-span-conjunction", Query: `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.request.kind="rpc"}`, Target: "span.retries", Supported: true},
		{Name: "no-cross-span-conjunction", Query: `{span.pred.a="left" && span.pred.b="right"}`, Target: "span.retries", Supported: true},
		{Name: "regex", Query: `{span.request.kind=~"a.*"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "regex-full-anchoring", Query: `{span.request.kind=~"p"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "regex-newline", Query: `{span.filter.text=~"first.*second"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "regex-alternation", Query: `{span.request.kind=~"api|rpc"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "same-target-regex", Query: `{span.request.kind=~"a.*"}`, Target: "span.request.kind", Supported: true},
		{Name: "all-owner-spans", Query: `{resource.service.name=~"worker"}`, Target: "span.request.kind", Supported: true},
		{Name: "missing-on-matching-span", Query: `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.request.kind="api"}`, Target: "span.only.sibling", Supported: true},
		{Name: "present-on-matching-span", Query: `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.request.kind="rpc"}`, Target: "span.only.sibling", Supported: true},
		{Name: "no-bool-string-coercion", Query: `{span.cached="false"}`, Target: "resource.service.name", Supported: true},
		{Name: "bool-values", Query: `{resource.service.name="worker"}`, Target: "span.cached", Supported: true},
		{Name: "empty-value", Query: `{span.request.kind="api"}`, Target: "span.empty", Supported: true},
		{Name: "absent-value", Query: `{span.request.kind="api"}`, Target: "span.absent", Supported: true},
		{Name: "no-match", Query: `{resource.service.name="absent"}`, Target: "span.retries", Supported: true},
		// Actual upstream returns query literals without proving any stored match.
		// Pulse explicitly refuses this rather than reporting an invented stored value.
		{Name: "query-literal-shortcut", Query: `{span.request.kind="invented" && resource.service.name="absent"}`, Target: "span.request.kind", Supported: false},
	}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(c.Target)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		fetcher := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
			return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, req, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
		})
		err = engine.ExecuteTagValues(ctx, tag, c.Query, traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false }), fetcher)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		vals := []tempopb.TagValue{}
		for v := range set {
			vals = append(vals, v)
		}
		sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
			if vals[i].Type == vals[j].Type {
				return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
			}
			return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
		})
		c.Response = map[string]interface{}{"tagValues": vals}
		// Optional one-off actual public protobuf consumer, not a replay dependency.
		if c.Supported {
			wire, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-filtered/" + c.Name + ".protobuf")
			if err == nil {
				var actual tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response
				if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, &actual); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				expected := tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				for i := range vals {
					expected.TagValues = append(expected.TagValues, &vals[i])
				}
				got, _ := json.Marshal(&actual)
				want, _ := json.Marshal(&expected)
				if string(got) != string(want) {
					t.Fatalf("public protobuf consumer mismatch %s: %s vs %s", c.Name, got, want)
				}
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-filtered"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
